posts.trend: India Inc braces for muted salary hikes in 2027 as costs rise, hiring slows
posts.context: Mid-level corporate workers undergo standard annual performance reviews that offer no financial upside.
posts.angle: The annual compensation review is an agreed script where both sides pretend a 2% hike is news.
slides: "What are your salary expectations for next year?"

"Matching inflation."
"We operate in a challenging market."
"Matching my rent increment."
"Thoda adjust kar lo."
You both smiled and signed the annexure.
posts.caption: Send this to the colleague who actually thought the variable pay was coming. 💼
posts.rank_verdict: Needs a specific brand or concrete rupee figure in the middle slide to ground the conversation.
